verdict.rationale: Solid's own README says it has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration aimed at reaching interactivity as quickly as possible. It also lists streaming SSR and isomorphic client/server rendering among its features, says it is fast on the server, and supports Node LTS, Deno and Cloudflare Workers runtimes. These are README-level feature claims only: the pack has no detailed docs and no hands-on reports of streaming. One community comment advises avoiding Suspense, but it does not concretely contradict streaming SSR. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the streaming SSR API and hydration behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration that streaming improves time-to-interactive.
